title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Update Your Payment Method
content:
If a user wants to update their payment method:

- Guide them to the CultPass app > 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods'
- They can add a new card or remove an old one
- The next billing cycle will automatically use the newly selected default method
- If a payment fails, the user has a 3-day grace period before the subscription is suspended

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your payment method in the CultPass app under 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods'. Your next charge will use the new default method automatically."

title: What to Do If an Event Is Cancelled
content:
If an experience is cancelled by the organizer:

- Affected users are notified automatically via push notification and email
- Their reservation is refunded to their monthly quota (does not count as used)
- Suggest similar upcoming experiences from the catalog
- If the user wants a cash refund instead of quota credit, escalate to support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"We're sorry, that experience was cancelled by the organizer. Your reservation has been refunded to your monthly quota, so it won't count as used. Would you like help finding a similar experience?"

title: How to Redeem a Gift Subscription
content:
Gift subscriptions are purchased separately and delivered via a redemption code:

- Ask the user to go to 'My Account' > 'Redeem Code'
- The code activates a new subscription or extends an existing one by the gifted duration
- Codes are case-sensitive and expire 12 months after purchase
- If a code doesn't work, verify it hasn't already been redeemed before escalating

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can redeem your gift code under 'My Account' > 'Redeem Code'. Just enter the code exactly as received, and your subscription will be activated or extended right away."

title: How to Change Your Registered Email
content:
Users can update their account email address as follows:

- Go to 'My Account' > 'Profile' > 'Edit Email'
- A verification link is sent to the new address
- The old email remains active until verification is completed
- If the user no longer has access to their old email, escalate to support lead for manual verification

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can change your email in 'My Account' > 'Profile' > 'Edit Email'. We'll send a confirmation link to your new address to complete the change."

title: What Happens If a User Is Blocked
content:
Accounts may be blocked for suspicious activity, repeated no-shows, or policy violations:

- Blocked users cannot make new reservations but retain access to past history
- Do NOT unblock an account without approval from the support lead
- Explain the reason for the block if known, and outline the appeal process
- Appeals are reviewed within 5 business days

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your account is currently blocked, which prevents new reservations. If you believe this is a mistake, I can submit an appeal on your behalf — appeals are typically reviewed within 5 business days."

title: How to Join the Waitlist for a Full Event
content:
When an experience has no available slots:

- Users can tap 'Join Waitlist' on the experience page
- They are notified automatically if a slot opens up, with 30 minutes to confirm
- Waitlist position is based on join time, not subscription tier
- Joining a waitlist does not use any of the user's monthly quota until confirmed

**Suggested phrasing:**
"That experience is full, but you can join the waitlist from the event page. If a spot opens up, you'll get a notification with 30 minutes to confirm your reservation."

title: How to Upgrade or Downgrade Your Subscription Tier
content:
Tier changes are managed from 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan' > 'Change Tier':

- Upgrades take effect immediately, with the price difference prorated for the current cycle
- Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle
- Monthly quota adjusts automatically to match the new tier
- Premium-only experiences become unavailable immediately after a downgrade takes effect

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can change your tier under 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan' > 'Change Tier'. Upgrades apply right away, while downgrades take effect at your next billing cycle."

title: Lost or Not Receiving Your QR Code
content:
The QR code is required for event check-in and is generated per reservation:

- It can always be found in the app under 'My Reservations' > select the event
- If the user doesn't see it, confirm the reservation status is 'reserved' and not 'cancelled'
- QR codes do not need to be emailed separately — the app is the source of truth
- For offline access, suggest taking a screenshot before arriving at the venue

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can always find your QR code in the app under 'My Reservations' — just tap the event. I'd recommend taking a screenshot in case you don't have signal at the venue."

title: How to Request a Refund
content:
Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis:

- Standard subscription fees are non-refundable once the billing cycle has started
- Exceptions: event cancelled by organizer, duplicate charge, or proven billing error
- Do NOT promise a refund directly — collect details and escalate to the support lead for approval
- Approved refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I understand the concern — refunds for cases like this need approval from our support lead. I'll log the details now and follow up as soon as it's reviewed, usually within 5-7 business days."

title: How to Contact Human Support
content:
If the AI assistant cannot resolve the issue:

- Offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent
- Set the ticket status to 'escalated' and summarize the conversation so far
- Let the user know typical response time is within 24 hours on business days
- Never leave the user without a next step or expected timeline

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I'll go ahead and connect you with one of our human support agents who can help further. They typically respond within 24 hours on business days, and I've shared a summary of our conversation with them."
